CheckTitle: Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater
Description: The IAM account password policy must require a minimum password length of 14 characters. Longer passwords are exponentially harder to brute-force and substantially reduce the risk of credential guessing attacks.
Risk: Passwords shorter than 14 characters are more susceptible to brute-force and dictionary attacks. Short passwords reduce the entropy of the credential set across all IAM users in the account.
Remediation: Update the IAM account password policy to require a minimum length of 14 characters via the AWS Management Console (IAM > Account settings) or CLI: aws iam update-account-password-policy --minimum-password-length 14.
SeverityBasis: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0 Control 1.8 (Level 1); NIST SP 800-63B Section 5.1.1.2 recommends minimum 8 characters; CIS raises the bar to 14 for cloud environments
AuthoritativeSource: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0; NIST SP 800-63B
